recent_calls.summary: Christopher called to schedule a cooling service appointment for his home at 4225 Garfield Avenue due to his system blowing hot air and the outside fan not turning. He requested service on Tuesday at any time and declined information about maintenance programs. The agent confirmed the details and received positive feedback from Christopher.

The agent confirmed his contact details and service address, noted his preference to be called before the technician arrives, and assured that the team will reach out on the next business day to schedule the appointment.
